worldcombat.skill.shoreup.summary: Sweeps the loose sand at its feet up and packs it over its wounds, restoring about half of maximum health; denser sand restores more and a sandstorm brings it to about two thirds. It only reads the sand in the ground and never digs load-bearing blocks, so the surface stays intact; only loose sand items dropped at its feet are consumed.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.use.0: A big restore while standing on sand
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.use.1: Drink from a sandstorm's endless sand
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.use.2: Gather the drifted sand underfoot for one strong restore
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.description.0: A single self-heal, restoring %1$s of maximum health: denser loose sand restores more, a sandstorm adds more (up to about 2/3 on sand), and higher Defence packs a thicker coat. It cannot be used at full health.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.description.1: Reads up to %1$s real sand spots within %2$s blocks as its source; the sand blocks stay in the ground and the surface stays continuous, and only loose sand items actually dropped there are consumed.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.description.2: Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s; a higher Speed shortens both.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.stance.thick: Thick pack: more sand and more healing per cast (x1.12), at the cost of a slower wind-up, a longer cooldown and more loose sand taken - for a big restore on deep sand.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.stance.loose: Thin spread: a faster wind-up, less loose sand taken and a shorter cooldown, with slightly less healing - for small top-ups in place.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s, entering a %4$s s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shoreup.preference.thi: On: more sand and more healing (about x1.12), but a slower wind-up, a longer cooldown and more loose sand taken. Off: faster, less loose sand and a shorter cooldown, with slightly less healing.
The companion shores up below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher tops up at the first wound.
